title: Check the verification status of your account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the current verification status of your Business Center or ad account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/status/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {+Conditional}|string|Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` has to be set.

The ID of the ad account that you want to check the verification status for.

To retrieve the list of ad accounts that you can access, use [/bc/asset/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-assets/v1.3) and set `asset_type` to `ADVERTISER`.| |bc_id {+Conditional}|string|Either `advertiser_id` or `bc_id` has to be set.

The ID of the Business Center account that you want to check the verification status for.

To retrieve the list of Business Centers that you can access, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3).| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/status/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|qualification_id|string|The qualification image ID of the verification document you submitted for your Business Center or ad account.

If you want to create Organization Accounts within an Agency Business Center, you can pass this ID to `qualification_id` in [/bc/oa/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-an-organization-account-in-a-business-center/v1.3).| #|verification_status|string|The current verification status of the ad account or Business Center account.

Enum values:
  • `NOT_SUBMITTED`: The verification has not been submitted.
  • `REVIEWING`: The verification is currently under review.
  • `VERIFIED`: The account has been verified successfully.
  • `FAILED`: The verification has failed.
  • `EXPIRED`: The verification has expired.
| #|rejection_reason|string|Returned only when `verification_status` is `FAILED`.

The reason for rejecting the verification request.

For common rejection reasons and troubleshooting suggestions, see [List of common rejection reasons and suggestions for verification failures](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/list-of-common-rejection-reasons-and-suggestions-for-verification-failures).| #|audit_time|string|The time when the review of the verification request was completed, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2026-07-08 10:30:58`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "audit_time": "2026-07-08 10:30:58", "qualification_id": "{{qualification_id}}", "rejection_reason": "{{rejection_reason}}", "verification_status": "FAILED" } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Check the verification status of your account on TikTok
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve the current verification status of your TikTok Business Center or ad account.
